note: Small Alberta Parks recreation-area campground in the Highwood River valley, 22 km W of Longview on Hwy 541, run by Kananaskis Campground Services: one loop between the highway and the river, the east-side pads behind a narrow row of trees on the bank. Hand-pump water is for fires only; the nearest sani-dump is at Highwood House day use. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Sep 18, 2026) and the operator's page: unserviced C$31, FCFS, vault toilets, hand pump not potable, season May 14 - Sep 6 (stored approximate 05-15/09-07 replaced). 13 sites (operator says 16). Riverfront -> riverview recommended. Phone 403-591-7226 found.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront - recommend riverview): both Alberta Parks ('This campground features exceptional waterfront campsites along the Highwood River') and the operator ('exceptional waterfront campsites ideal for anglers') claim waterfront. On imagery the loop runs N-S between Hwy 541 and the river; the pads on the east side of the loop road (about 6-8, plus the north-end turnout where an RV was parked) sit ~15-25 m from the water, but a continuous single row of willow/cottonwood lines the bank between every pad and the channel (a gravel bar shows beyond the trees at the middle of the loop); the west-side pads are ~45-60 m back across the road. The river is ~40-70 m wide (riverfront, not creekside, by width). Trees on the bank fail 'only open ground between'; with the official 'waterfront' wording a filtered river view from the east pads is clear, so riverview. No site numbers published (no shop listing, no tear sheet with numbers).
PHONE (stored empty): the page's 'Information: 403-591-7226'. 'Facility Operator: Kananaskis Campground Services Inc.' (website kananaskiscampgrounds.com; no phone on its page).
SITE COUNT: Alberta Parks table 13 unserviced; the operator's Highwood Valley page says '16 Total Sites'. Wrote 13 (agency table).
SEASON: 'Season: May 14 - Sep 6' (2026). Not on shop.albertaparks.ca (FCFS), so no 2027 'Closed through' date.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). No Kananaskis Conservation Pass line on this page.
DUMP: none at the campground; 'Sewage disposal station available at Highwood House Day Use' (put in the note, not facilities.dump).
WEBSITE: stored URL answered 200 and is this campground. Max rig length not published anywhere read.

PIN (50.45545,-114.42692): in the open field inside the loop road ~150-190 m WSW of the riverside pads; the page's directions point 50.456395,-114.425746 is at the loop's south end. Under 250 m, no move required; 50.4567,-114.4255 would sit on the pads.
